description: Business impressions on Google Maps on Desktop. Deduplicated per unique user per day. Additive daily count (Performance API DailyMetric).
Business impressions on Google Search on Desktop. Deduplicated per unique user per day. Additive daily count.
Business impressions on Google Maps on Mobile. Deduplicated per unique user per day. Additive daily count.

Business impressions on Google Search on Mobile. Deduplicated per unique user per day. Additive daily count. Total impressions = sum of the 4 BUSINESS_IMPRESSIONS_* metrics (Google exposes no single combined metric).
Number of message conversations received on the business profile. Additive daily count.
Number of times directions to the business location were requested. Additive daily count.
Number of times the call button was clicked. Additive daily count.
Number of times the website link was clicked. Additive daily count.
Number of bookings made from the profile via Reserve with Google. Additive daily count.
Number of food orders received from the profile. Additive daily count.
Number of clicks to view/interact with menu content. Deduplicated per unique user per day. Additive daily count.
Reporting day (YYYY-MM-DD), from the Performance API datedValues[].date. Daily grain. Zero-days may be omitted by the API and are gap-filled to 0 by the connector.

The reporting entity: Business Profile location id (resource name locations/{location_id}). Stamped on every row; the Performance and Reviews endpoints are scoped by this id. Discovered via Account Management accounts.list -> Business Information accounts.locations.list.
Business Profile account id (accounts/{account_id}) owning the location. Resolved from the topology parent; the v4 reviews path needs the account+location pair.
Human-readable location name (Business Information Location.title). Label for the location_id. Planned.
A search term users typed to find the business (searchkeywords.impressions.monthly). MONTHLY granularity only -- a separate monthly fact, never merged with the daily metrics stream.

Exact monthly impressions for a search keyword (insightsValue.value). Additive ACROSS KEYWORDS WITHIN A MONTH; the monthly grain is never merged into the daily fact. NULL when the keyword fell under the privacy floor -- read search_keyword_impressions_threshold then.
Encrypted unique review id (legacy My Business API v4 accounts.locations.reviews.list). The supersede key of the reviews fact.
Rating a reviewer gave, as a 1..5 LEVEL (v4 enum ONE..FIVE; the STAR_RATING_UNSPECIFIED sentinel lands NULL, never 0 -- 0 is not a value on this scale). NON-ADDITIVE: averaged, never summed.
Review free-text body (nullable -- a rating without text is normal).
Review creation timestamp (RFC 3339). The additive new_reviews count is derived from it.
Reviewer display name. PII -- persisted lean and NULLED when reviewer.isAnonymous is true; the reviewer photo URL is never persisted at all.
Owner reply text to the review (<=4096 bytes, nullable).
Location average star rating (reviews.list aggregate). NON-ADDITIVE: a level read by last-value, never summed.
Location total review count (reviews.list aggregate). A LEVEL, not a flow: last-value, never summed.
Timestamp of the last edit to the review (RFC 3339). Drives the supersede order so a re-pull keeps the freshest text of each review.
Whether the reviewer asked to stay anonymous. Landed so the anonymisation is auditable rather than merely applied.
Timestamp of the last edit to the owner reply (RFC 3339, nullable). Freshness of the response, not of the review.
Reporting month (YYYY-MM). The response carries no month, so it is stamped from the month REQUESTED: the connector asks one month at a time and the grain is observed rather than assumed.

Privacy FLOOR returned instead of an exact count for a low-volume keyword ('fewer than N'). NON-ADDITIVE by nature: summing floors produces a number that is neither a bound nor a count. Mutually exclusive with search_keyword_impressions.
True when the provider returned a threshold instead of a count. The flag that keeps a floor from being read as a measurement.

Date a Business Profile local post was published (localPost.createTime, legacy v4 localPosts edge). Canonical event_type social_post; label = localPost.summary. Landed as a context_events pulse (value null), never a metric.
